name: hw12_13_min_max_average_same_day
description: Test 13 (HW9). Both flags are tested after the loop, so with from = to and no point on that date GetPoint runs twice and its value counts twice. One point (10, 4), from = to = 15: GetPoint(15) gives 4 twice: min = max = 4, avg 8 / 2 = 4. Points (10, 4) and (20, 8): GetPoint(15) gives 6 twice, avg 6. With a point on that date (20) neither call happens: 8, 8, 8.
